title: This handy Google Pixel feature can help solve annoying Android Bluetooth problems - Engadget
summary: On our Pixel 8 Pro test, we discovered Bluetooth Diagnostics in Settings > Connected devices . Wireless Android Auto uses both Bluetooth and Wi-Fi , which means Bluetooth can be working just fine while Android Auto is still throwing a fit.
